primitives.title: Cross-session SendMessage + ListAgents
primitives.retires: Hand-rolled agent-to-agent message bus (HTTP inbox between sessions, shell scripts that shell out to another agent).
primitives.note: Sessions discover each other with ListAgents and message by name, on any of your machines. This is the real replacement for bespoke session-to-session wiring.

primitives.title: Permission-classified inbound messages
primitives.signature: evaluated by the permission classifier before dispatch
primitives.retires: Custom allow-listing / auth on your own message endpoint to stop one agent driving another unsafely.
primitives.note: Messages to another session are classified before delivery, and messages to a bypass-permissions session are held for approval (crossSessionInbound / dialogExpiry settings).

primitives.title: context:fork skills run in background
primitives.retires: Manually detaching a skill/subtask so it does not block the main conversation.
primitives.note: Forked skills background by default (opt out with background:false). Your orchestration keeps working; just drop the manual detach.

primitives.title: Nested subagents (depth > 1)
primitives.retires: Flattening a naturally-nested fan-out into one layer because sub-agents could not themselves spawn.
primitives.note: Depth is capped and configurable (CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH). Check the default on your version before relying on deep nesting.

primitives.title: Concurrent-subagent cap
primitives.retires: Your own semaphore to stop one message fanning out unbounded agents.
primitives.note: Default cap exists (CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS). If your workflow assumed unlimited parallelism, it is now bounded.

primitives.title: 200-subagent lifetime cap removed
primitives.retires: Restarting a long session to dodge the old lifetime spawn ceiling.
primitives.note: Long-running sessions no longer refuse new agents; concurrency and depth limits still apply.

ingress.retires: Nothing. An external event source (phone share-sheet, webhook, cron, email watcher) still needs your own endpoint to land it in an agent.
ingress.note: Cross-session messaging is agent-to-agent only. If a device or third-party service outside Claude Code has to reach an agent, that intake stays bespoke. Do not retire it because messaging shipped.
